name: stacklenzz-kit
description: Stacklenzz - Developer-first backend observability system and UI ecosystem

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ui && npm run build:cli
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:ui && npm run test:cli
scripts.publish:server: npm run build:server && npm run test:server && npm --prefix observability-server publish --access public
scripts.publish:ui: npm run build:ui && npm run test:ui && npm --prefix observability-ui publish --access public
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build:cli && npm run test:cli && npm --prefix observability-cli publish --access public
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:server && npm run publish:ui && npm run publish:cli
